title: MdePackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly mde (INV-REQ-480, INV-REQ-483, INV-REQ-486, INV-REQ-412): the MDE binding table, one row per Business Term ID, with both cardinalities (PINT-SG cardinality per specification version, IRAS MDE status) and the syntax path per specification version. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, tested by the consumers: businessTermId is unique across rows; specificationVersion is unique within one row; the stricter of the two (INV-REQ-483) is the Layer 2 check of payload-svc, which requires every row whose irasStatus is MANDATORY, or MANDATORY_IN_SCENARIOS in a listed scenario, for the document's type code and submission type, whatever pintCardinality says; a transaction that is both POS and STI takes POS, applied by canonical-svc (INV-REQ-412 behavior 1). No row content is written here; the rows are pack content. irasStatus and pintCardinality are vocabularies of this contract, not field mappings. A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

businessTermId.description: The Business Term ID of the MDE.

canonicalSource.description: The canonical source field the term is read from.

dataType.description: The data type of the term.

documentTypeCodes.description: The document type codes the row applies to. A pattern, not an enum, because API-09 forbids numeric enum members.

submissionTypes.description: The submission types the row applies to.

irasStatus.description: The IRAS MDE status of the term.

requiredInScenarios.description: The scenarios in which the term is required; present only when irasStatus is MANDATORY_IN_SCENARIOS.

bindingStatus.description: Whether the binding of the row is provisional (INV-REQ-491 behavior 2). A row is PROVISIONAL only while an answer that can change its binding is open; the answer arrives as a pack release that sets the row CONFIRMED. The marker is per row. Absent means CONFIRMED.

provisionalReference.description: The open question that makes the row PROVISIONAL; present only when bindingStatus is PROVISIONAL.

sourceClass.description: The source class of the entry (INV-REQ-727, INV-REQ-774). Every entry carries a class, and a pack with an entry lacking a citation or class is refused by rules-svc at import and at dry run (INV-AC-1727). An entry without this property is never read as PRIMARY. The property is optional only because a property is never made required within a major version (API-41, FR-K.4).

sourceReference.description: The source reference of the row.

specifications.description: The binding per specification version, with the PINT-SG cardinality of that version.

pintCardinality.description: The PINT-SG cardinality in this specification version.

syntaxPath.description: The syntax path the term is bound to in this specification version.

aggregateDefaults.description: The aggregate literals: per aggregate type, the literal written to the business term.

businessTermId.description: The Business Term ID the literal is written to.

offNetworkEndpoint.description: The prefix written before the customer's UEN in the Customer Endpoint ID (IBT-049) of an off-network document, rule-pack configuration (INV-REQ-321, INV-Q-7189). Absent means no prefix is configured and the consumer builds no off-network endpoint ID. The schema holds no value: the provisional value is seed data.

prefix.description: The prefix written before the customer's UEN.
